user.title: Android Meter
user.description: Name the meter the phone will watch.

pair.title: Pair the phone
pair.description:
**Pair the phone with this code**

1. On the phone, open the camera app and point it at the QR code below.
2. Tap **Share** on the text the camera shows and pick **Android Meter**. If the camera only offers Copy, copy it, open Android Meter and press **Paste the pairing link**.
3. Android Meter asks whether to send the pictures to this Home Assistant. Check the address and tap **Use it**.

To type the address instead: `{webhook_url}`

The phone must be on the same network as Home Assistant. Once the first picture has arrived, open this integration's options to set the crop and teach it the reading.

data_description.qr_code: Scan with the phone's camera app, then share the text to Android Meter. It holds this Home Assistant's address.

teach.title: Teach the reading

data_description.reading: Every drum, decimals included, with a point or a comma before the decimals.
data_description.forget: Start learning again, for instance after a wrong reading was taught. Changing the crop forgets them anyway.

counter.title: Crop and counter
counter.description: Last picture: {frame} pixels. Look at the Frame image entity to place the crop: from the top left corner of the first drum window to the bottom right corner of the last one, the windows only. Each window is outlined there once saved. Changing the crop forgets the digits learnt.

data_description.rotation: How far to turn the picture clockwise so the digits stand upright. The crop is measured on the turned picture.
data_description.gap: Width of the housing between two windows, in pixels of the picture.
data_description.digits: Number of drums, decimal ones included.
data_description.decimals: Drums after the decimal point, usually red.

phone.title: Phone and pairing
phone.description: To pair a phone, scan the pairing code below with its camera app and share the text to Android Meter. The phone posts to `{webhook_url}`.

data_description.qr_code: Scan with the phone's camera app, then share the text to Android Meter. It holds this Home Assistant's address.
data_description.interval: How long the phone waits between two pictures.
data_description.torch: Light the meter for each picture.
data_description.max_flow: The most the meter can pass. 6 m³/h for a G4 meter, 10 for a G6. Readings that would need more are refused.

error.bad_reading: This reading does not fit the counter: check the number of drums and decimal drums.
error.crop_outside: The crop goes past the edge of the last frame.
error.windows_too_small: The windows are too small: each needs at least 4 pixels across and 8 down.
error.too_many_decimals: There cannot be more decimal drums than drums.
error.no_crop: Set the crop before teaching a reading.
error.no_frame: No frame has arrived yet to teach the reading from.
error.nothing_at_rest: No drum shows a whole digit on the last frame. Wait for the meter to stop and try again.
error.no_reading: Type the reading the picture shows, or tick Forget the digits learnt.
